entities.summary: Daniel Fernando Abugattás Majluf was a Peruvian businessman and politician belonging to the Alliance for Progress. He was previously a Congressman representing the constituency of Lima from 2006 to 2016 and formerly belonged to the Peruvian Nationalist Party.
